single.deferred: Preflight performs no simulation. Use train or --execute to run the configured experiment.
single.cost_note: Bounds cover one configured execution; candidate deduplication or interruption can reduce runs. No time, memory or byte estimate is inferred from event counts.

dual.deferred: Preflight performs no simulation. Use train or --execute to run the configured experiment.
dual.cost_note: Bounds cover one configured execution; candidate deduplication or interruption can reduce runs. No time, memory or byte estimate is inferred from event counts.

impact: Current-source preflight observations and evaluation EOF exit evidence only; unchanged training/simulator algorithms inherit accepted closure/Java semantics. Historical source IDs remain historical; not claimed as new current-source trials.
limitations: No paper-scale training or paper-table/numerical reproduction.
No numeric ERC search, parallel speedup or arbitrary checkpoint resume.
Java/Python native RNG streams may differ; controlled local alignment is not arbitrary-input equivalence.
Two optional old large native fixed projections remain NOT_EXECUTED and are outside required minimum scope.
JDK17 is an external environment requirement, not bundled. Offline dependency wheels target CPython3.12/Linux x86_64.
Legacy JUnit case count is not an instrumented simulation total.
